title: Train/Serve Skew Detector
hints: Deduplicate serving rows first: per entity keep the greatest ts, and on a tie the later row. Then join on entity_id, never on position.
A missing value is an absent key or None. It is not 0. Missing vs present is a mismatch, and both missing is a match.
bool is a subclass of int in Python. A feature is numeric only if every non-missing value on both sides is an int or float and not a bool.
Distances use every row on each side, not just the joined ones: the population std of the training values for numeric features, total variation distance for categorical ones.
